# Users and Permissions

Manage users and roles, role permissions and user permissions.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Users and Roles](users-and-roles.md) | Create users, give them roles, group roles with Role Profiles, limit modules with Module Profiles, and set password, login and two-factor rules. |
| [Role Permissions](permissions.md) | Set what each role can do on each DocType with the Role Permissions Manager, permission levels, rights, "Only If Creator" and custom Permission Types. |
| [User Permissions](user-permissions.md) | Limit a user to specific records with User Permission, including applicable DocTypes, default values, descendants, strict mode and the permitted documents report. |
